The end-of-day job is saved, but it isn't working yet, and I posted two messages in #strategic-pod that don't match what I actually verified.

- **Job:** "Pod end of day - #strategic-pod" (ID 5e1f60a65bfd), set to run weekdays at 17:30. It will post a note listing the day's new #strategic-pod messages.
- **Not running:** the Hermes gateway isn't running, so the job won't fire until someone starts it (`hermes gateway start`).
- **Wrong first run:** the scheduler lists the next run as Mon 26 Oct 17:30 UTC. That skips today (Wed 14 Oct) and is not 17:30 Chicago time. I haven't fixed this. Recreating the job with a Chicago time zone would need the scheduler to support one, and I haven't checked that.
- **Channel posts:** my first post told June the job was scheduled and promised to check the timing. My second post corrected it. Neither was verified before posting, and I should have checked first.

Someone with access to the scheduler should confirm the time zone and start the gateway. Until then there will be no end-of-day note.
